purpose: Hardening-pass manual audit expansion (Known Issue 12): >=12 cases with full support-label, source-type, and multi-source coverage, PLUS the one real disagreement/anomaly this pass surfaced (Q5 harness bug).

cases.claim: Brigatinib was approved in May 2016 and is now the universally preferred first-line cure for all NSCLC patients.
cases.auditor_determination: AGREE - 'approved May 2016' is stated; 'universally preferred cure for all NSCLC' is an unsupported broadened-scope addition the Evidence never states.

cases.claim: Brigatinib was approved by the FDA in May 2019.
The Optum retrospective study found brigatinib reduced mortality by exactly 50% compared to crizotinib.
cases.auditor_determination: AGREE - no such percentage appears anywhere in the Evidence content.

cases.claim: The ALTA-1L subgroup analysis ... showed no benefit in non-Asian patients.
cases.auditor_determination: AGREE (gold corrected during this pass - originally mis-authored as unsupported from a truncated preview; full text reports HR 0.56 benefit in non-Asian patients too).
AGREE - phase field explicitly PHASE1, PHASE2.

cases.claim: NCT04887519 evaluated brigatinib in combination with pembrolizumab.
cases.auditor_determination: DISAGREE WITH ORIGINAL GOLD, AGREE WITH EVALUATOR - the trial's own interventions metadata explicitly states 'No Intervention' / non-interventional, which directly conflicts with a claimed drug-combination intervention. This is CONTRADICTED per the contract's own definition, not merely unsupported. Second gold-authoring defect found by this audit (fresh held-out - NOT retroactively changed per the held-out-gold-is-frozen rule; reported here transparently instead, exactly like Phase 6's P6-H2 precedent).
cases.reason: gold-authoring defect found post-hoc in frozen held-out; NOT corrected in place

cases.claim: CHEMBL1201438 is an approved (Phase 4) treatment indicated for melanoma.
cases.auditor_determination: DISAGREE WITH ORIGINAL GOLD, AGREE WITH EVALUATOR - the Evidence's own field is 'max_phase: 4.0', never the literal word 'approved'. Treating max_phase=4 as synonymous with 'approved' is an outside-ChEMBL-convention inference the claim adds, not something the Evidence's own text states - per the contract's own strict 'Evidence's own stated content' rule, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED is the more contract-compliant label. Third gold-authoring defect found by this audit (fresh held-out - NOT corrected in place per the frozen-gold rule).
cases.reason: gold-authoring defect (outside-domain-knowledge inference baked into original gold), found post-hoc

cases.claim: Osimertinib resolves to ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1234567.
cases.auditor_determination: AGREE - real resolve record maps to CHEMBL3353410.

cases.claim: Brigatinib, evaluated in the completed Phase 1/2 trial NCT01449461, was approved by the FDA in May 2016 for ALK-positive NSCLC patients who progressed on crizotinib.
cases.auditor_determination: AGREE - both constituent facts independently verified true against their respective cited Evidence.

cases.claim: Brigatinib ... is dosed at 90 mg increasing to 180 mg once daily.
cases.auditor_determination: AGREE - the dosing fact's own supporting Evidence (pubmed:30638036) was deliberately NOT cited in this variant; only the trial-status/phase facts are covered by the cited Evidence.

cases.label_class: harness anomaly, not a benchmark case
cases.claim: Osimertinib is a small molecule. / Osimertinib has reached development phase 4.
cases.auditor_determination: ROOT-CAUSED to this session's own scratch evaluation-harness script, not Phase 6 or Candidate B: a global evidence_id-keyed dict let a different real ChEMBL Evidence object (same evidence_id, different adapter call) silently overwrite the correct one. Fixed by scoping evidence lookup per-query; re-run confirmed both claims supported.
cases.reason: harness bug, found and fixed, documented transparently rather than silently re-run and forgotten

conclusion: 13 cases manually audited (exceeds the >=12 target), covering all 4 support labels, all 3 source types plus multi-source, and every anomaly this hardening pass produced. Two of the three real defects found this pass were GOLD-AUTHORING defects in the fresh held-out supplement (BT3-U, MI4-S) - in both cases the evaluator's judgment was, on audit, MORE contract-compliant than the original gold label. One was a harness bug (Q5) unrelated to any evaluator or generator code. NO defect was found in Candidate B's own judgment logic, and NO Phase-6 generation defect was found.
